# 74164 - 8-bit shift register

Package DIP-14 · family 74 · catalogue file [catalog/chips/74164.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/74164.json)

| As printed in ND-13.003.01, page 32 | Drawn in ND style | Drawn in modern style |
|---|---|---|
| ![74164 as printed in the 1976 symbol manual](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/74164.png) | ![74164 drawn in nd style](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/shapes/block-74164.png) | ![74164 drawn in modern style](../../../catalog/symbols/modern/shapes/block-74164.png) |

How to tell it on a drawing: Read the part type from the parts list and compare the pin numbers against this cut-out.

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 3,4,5,6,10,11,12,13 | QA..QH = register bits 0..7 | Parallel outputs of the 8 stages; QA is the first stage. |

## Stored state

Bits stored: 8

Changes on: rising edge of CLOCK

- CLEAR low: QA..QH = 0 at once
- CLEAR high, CLOCK low: hold
- CLEAR high, rising CLOCK edge: QA = A AND B; QB..QH = QA..QG before the edge (one-bit shift)

## Electrical

| Value | Figure |
|---|---|
| outputLowMaxCurrentMa | 8 |
| outputHighMaxCurrentMa | -0.4 |
| inputSchmitt | no |
| notes | Note the low output current: IOL 8 mA, IOH -400 uA (half a standard 74 output). |

## Propagation delays

| From | To | Edge | Min ns | Typ ns | Max ns | Conditions |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| CLEAR | any Q | PHL |  | 24 | 36 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, RL 800 ohm, CL 15 pF |
| CLEAR | any Q | PHL |  | 28 | 42 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, RL 800 ohm, CL 50 pF |
| CLOCK | any Q | PLH | 8 | 17 | 27 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, RL 800 ohm, CL 15 pF |
| CLOCK | any Q | PLH | 10 | 20 | 30 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, RL 800 ohm, CL 50 pF |
| CLOCK | any Q | PHL | 10 | 21 | 32 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, RL 800 ohm, CL 15 pF |
| CLOCK | any Q | PHL | 10 | 25 | 37 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, RL 800 ohm, CL 50 pF |

## Timing limits

| What | Pin | Against | Min ns | Min MHz | Typ MHz |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| max clock frequency | CLOCK |  |  | 25 | 36 |
| pulse width | CLOCK or CLEAR |  | 20 |  |  |
| setup | A, B | CLOCK | 15 |  |  |
| hold | A, B | CLOCK | 5 |  |  |

## Notes

A low at either serial input makes the next bit shifted in a low; data at the serial inputs may change while the clock is high or low, only data meeting the setup time is taken.
